findings.title: No Documented API Interface
findings.description: The application serves HTML pages via Django views (ticket_list, ticket_search). No REST, GraphQL, or AsyncAPI interface exists. Integration requires UI automation or direct database access.
findings.gap: No programmatic API interface exists. Only HTML-based web views or direct PostgreSQL access.
findings.recommendation: Build REST API with Django REST Framework after upgrading Python/Django to supported versions.

findings.title: No Machine-Readable API Specification
findings.description: No OpenAPI, Swagger, AsyncAPI, GraphQL schema, or Smithy specification files found in the repository.
findings.gap: No machine-readable API specification for agent tool generation.
findings.recommendation: Generate OpenAPI specification as part of REST API implementation using drf-spectacular.

findings.title: No Structured Error Responses
findings.description: DEBUG=True causes Django to serve HTML traceback pages on errors. No JSON error responses, no error codes, no retryable indicators.
findings.gap: No machine-readable error responses. Agents cannot distinguish retriable from terminal errors.
findings.recommendation: Implement DRF exception handler with structured JSON error bodies including error codes and retryable flags.

findings.title: Write Operations Not Idempotent
findings.description: Django admin provides CRUD operations with no idempotency key support. No idempotency middleware or unique constraint enforcement on business keys.
findings.gap: Write operations are not idempotent. Agent retries would create duplicate records.
findings.recommendation: Implement idempotency keys on all write endpoints when building the REST API.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND no idempotency support on write operations.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: Django admin provides CRUD operations (write surface detected). No idempotency keys or unique constraint enforcement visible.

blocker_remediation.immediate: Implement idempotency keys on write endpoints
blocker_remediation.target_state: All write endpoints accept idempotency key header; duplicates return original response

findings.title: HTML Response Format Only
findings.description: All responses are HTML. ticket_list uses Django template rendering. ticket_search returns raw HTML string concatenation. No JSON serialization.
findings.gap: No structured format suitable for agent consumption.
findings.recommendation: Implement JSON responses via Django REST Framework.

findings.title: No Event Emission for State Changes
findings.description: No event emission mechanism. No webhooks, SNS, EventBridge, SQS, or Kafka. Only SMTP email outbound.
findings.gap: No event-driven notification for ticket state changes.
findings.recommendation: Consider EventBridge integration for ticket status changes when modernizing.

findings.title: No Rate Limit Documentation or Headers
findings.description: No rate limits documented or enforced. No rate limit headers (X-RateLimit-Remaining, Retry-After) in responses.
findings.gap: Agents cannot self-throttle based on service feedback.
findings.recommendation: Implement rate limiting with standard headers when deploying behind API Gateway.

findings.title: No Machine Identity Authentication
findings.description: Only Django session-based authentication. No OAuth2 client credentials, API keys, mTLS, or service account support.
findings.gap: No machine identity authentication mechanism. Agents cannot authenticate with attributable identities.
findings.recommendation: Implement OAuth2 client credentials or API key authentication for machine callers.

blocker_remediation.immediate: Implement API key authentication for machine callers
blocker_remediation.target_state: OAuth2 client credentials flow with per-agent client IDs

findings.title: No Scoped Permissions for Machine Identities
findings.description: Django permissions system exists but no scoped configurations for machine identities. No IAM policies, no API-level authorization.
findings.gap: Cannot scope agent permissions to specific resources or operations.
findings.recommendation: Implement fine-grained permission model with OAuth2 scopes.

compensating_controls: Restrict agent to read-only at orchestration layer
Use Django groups with model permissions as baseline

findings.title: No Action-Level Authorization Enforcement
findings.description: Views enforce zero authorization. No @login_required, no permission checks. Unauthenticated access to all endpoints.
findings.gap: No action-level authorization. Cannot restrict agent to read-only on specific resource types.
findings.recommendation: Add Django permission decorators. Implement action-level checks in REST API.

compensating_controls: Implement middleware enforcing auth on all views

findings.title: No Identity Propagation
findings.description: No JWT, OAuth2, or token exchange. Session-based auth only. Cannot distinguish agent-as-self vs agent-on-behalf-of-user.
findings.gap: Cannot propagate or delegate identity through service calls.
findings.recommendation: Implement OAuth2 token exchange or JWT-based identity propagation.

compensating_controls: Implement custom X-On-Behalf-Of headers with server-side validation
Restrict to service-level operations without user context

findings.title: Credentials Hardcoded in Source Control
findings.description: SECRET_KEY ('x9d2#kf!3v_legacy_secret_do_not_change_2012') and database password ('helpdesk2012') are hardcoded in settings.py.
findings.gap: Credentials in source code. No secrets management or rotation. Vulnerable to prompt injection leakage.
findings.recommendation: Move to AWS Secrets Manager with rotation. Rotate exposed credentials immediately.

compensating_controls: Move to environment variables as interim step

findings.title: No Immutable Audit Logging
findings.description: No audit logging exists. No CloudTrail, no application-level audit trail, no immutable log storage. Only a print statement logging search queries.
findings.gap: No authenticated principal attribution on operations. No immutable audit trail.
findings.recommendation: Implement immutable audit logging (CloudTrail + S3 Object Lock) with principal identity for every operation.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND no audit logging.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: System has write operations (Django admin CRUD) with zero audit trail. Agent-initiated writes cannot be attributed or forensically investigated.

blocker_remediation.immediate: Add structured audit logging for all write operations
blocker_remediation.target_state: Immutable audit log with object lock logging principal identity for every write

findings.title: No Agent Identity Suspension Mechanism
findings.description: No mechanism to suspend or revoke individual agent identities. No machine identity system exists to suspend.
findings.gap: Cannot isolate a misbehaving agent without shutting down the entire application.
findings.recommendation: Implement API key revocation as part of machine identity system (AUTH-Q1 dependency).

findings.title: No Compensation or Rollback Capability
findings.description: No compensation or rollback mechanisms. No saga patterns, compensating transactions, or undo endpoints.
findings.gap: Failed multi-step workflows leave application in partial state.
findings.recommendation: Implement transaction boundaries and compensation endpoints for multi-step workflows.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND no rollback/compensation.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: System exposes write operations via Django admin with no compensation or rollback capability. Multi-step agent workflows cannot be safely unwound.

blocker_remediation.immediate: Implement database transaction boundaries for multi-step operations
blocker_remediation.target_state: Saga pattern or compensating transactions for all multi-step workflows

findings.title: State Queryable Only via HTML
findings.description: Ticket state is queryable via HTML views (ticket_list) but not via machine-readable API.
findings.gap: No programmatic state query interface for agents.
findings.recommendation: Expose JSON GET endpoints for ticket state in the REST API.

findings.title: No Concurrency Controls
findings.description: No optimistic locking, version fields, ETags, or conditional writes. Raw SQL with no transaction isolation.
findings.gap: Concurrent agent writes could corrupt data.
findings.recommendation: Add version fields to ticket models. Implement optimistic locking with ETag/If-Match.

compensating_controls: Add SELECT FOR UPDATE on critical paths

findings.title: No Circuit Breakers for External Dependencies
findings.description: SMTP relay to exchange.acme-corp.internal:25 has no circuit breaker, timeout, or retry logic.
findings.gap: External dependency failures cascade without mitigation.
findings.recommendation: Implement circuit breakers and async email processing via Celery/SQS.

findings.title: No Rate Limiting
findings.description: No rate limiting at any layer. No API Gateway, WAF, or application-level throttling.
findings.gap: No protection against runaway agent loops overwhelming the single EC2 instance.
findings.recommendation: Add rate limiting middleware or deploy behind API Gateway with throttling.

findings.title: No Blast Radius or Transaction Limits
findings.description: No configurable transaction limits, maximum records per operation, or per-caller business caps.
findings.gap: Unbounded blast radius for agent errors. An agent could modify/delete all tickets.
findings.recommendation: Implement per-agent transaction limits in the REST API layer.

compensating_controls: Per-request operation caps at API layer

findings.title: No Draft/Pending State
findings.description: No draft or pending state capability. Status field references 'OPEN' but no DRAFT/PENDING values. All writes commit immediately.
findings.gap: No mechanism for agent-proposed, human-reviewed changes.
findings.recommendation: Add DRAFT/PENDING status to ticket model. Implement two-step create-then-confirm workflow.

compensating_controls: Add PENDING_REVIEW status to ticket enum

findings.title: No Configurable Approval Gates
findings.description: No approval workflow, configurable gates, or human approval tasks. All operations execute immediately.
findings.gap: Cannot require human approval for high-risk agent operations.
findings.recommendation: Implement configurable approval gates per operation type.

findings.title: No Sandbox/Staging Environment
findings.description: No staging environment. Single EC2 with manual git pull deployment.
findings.gap: No safe environment to test agent behavior before production.
findings.recommendation: Create Docker-compose local environment and staging instance with anonymized data.

findings.title: Sensitive Data Exposed Without Scoping
findings.description: Stage A: System stores user PII (requester names, ticket content). Stage B/B1: ticket_list returns requester data without field filtering. No serializers or DTOs. B2: No access control differentiation. B3: No classification metadata.
findings.gap: Agent-facing responses include all sensitive fields without scoping.
findings.recommendation: Implement response serializers excluding sensitive fields. Create separate agent-facing DTOs with OAuth scope differentiation.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND sensitive fields returned in API responses without scoping (B1 fired).
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: ticket_list returns requester PII directly. No field filtering, no serializers, no access control differentiation between sensitive and non-sensitive data.

b1.reasoning: Requester PII returned in ticket_list with no field filtering. agent_scope=write-enabled.

b2.reasoning: No OAuth scopes, no RBAC granularity. Single-permission-level access.

b3.reasoning: No formal classification metadata, tags, or PII detection tooling.

blocker_remediation.immediate: Implement serializers that exclude sensitive fields from agent-facing endpoints
blocker_remediation.target_state: Field-level access control with OAuth scopes for sensitive data

findings.title: No Data Residency Controls
findings.description: User PII stored on single EC2 with no data residency documentation, region configuration, or controls preventing cross-region transmission.
findings.gap: No data residency policy or technical enforcement. Agent could transmit data cross-jurisdiction.
findings.recommendation: Document residency requirements. Implement region-locked controls for data transmission.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND PII stored with no residency documentation or controls.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: Helpdesk tickets contain user PII (requester information). No data residency policy exists. An agent transmitting this data to an LLM in a different jurisdiction could violate GDPR or other regulations.

blocker_remediation.immediate: Document data residency requirements for helpdesk ticket data
blocker_remediation.target_state: Documented policy with VPC endpoints and region-locked LLM endpoints

findings.title: No Pagination or Result Limits
findings.description: ticket_list and ticket_search return unbounded results via cursor.fetchall() with no pagination, limit, or cursor parameters.
findings.gap: Unbounded result sets could exhaust agent context windows.
findings.recommendation: Implement cursor-based pagination with configurable limits on all list/search endpoints.

findings.title: SQL Injection — No Input Validation
findings.description: Critical SQL injection vulnerabilities in both views via Python string formatting directly in SQL queries. No parameterized queries, no validation.
findings.gap: No input validation at any layer. Malformed agent inputs execute as SQL.
findings.recommendation: Replace all raw SQL string formatting with parameterized queries immediately. Add input validation framework.

findings.title: Limited Temporal Metadata
findings.description: A 'created' column exists but no 'updated_at' field. Timezone is America/New_York (not UTC). No freshness signaling headers.
findings.gap: Limited temporal metadata. No update timestamps or data freshness indicators.
findings.recommendation: Add updated_at field. Use UTC. Implement Last-Modified and Cache-Control headers.

findings.title: PII Leaks into Logs Without Redaction
findings.description: User search queries logged via print statement. DEBUG=True leaks full tracebacks with user data. No PII masking.
findings.gap: PII leaks directly into stdout/logs. Debug mode exposes sensitive internals.
findings.recommendation: Set DEBUG=False. Remove print statements. Implement structured logging with PII redaction.

compensating_controls: Remove print statements and implement proper logging

findings.title: No Data Quality Metrics
findings.description: No data quality metrics, completeness monitoring, or duplicate detection for helpdesk ticket data.
findings.gap: No data quality awareness for agent consumption.
findings.recommendation: Implement data quality monitoring as part of modernization.

findings.title: No Schema Versioning or API Contracts
findings.description: No schema versioning, API contracts, migration files, version prefixes, or changelog.
findings.gap: No versioning or contract stability. Agent tool bindings break silently.
findings.recommendation: Implement URL-based API versioning and schema comparison tools in CI.

findings.title: No Data Catalog or Metadata Layer
findings.description: No data catalog, metadata layer, or schema documentation describing the ticket data model.
findings.gap: No discoverable metadata about the data model.
findings.recommendation: Document data model in API specification.

findings.title: No Distributed Tracing or Structured Logging
findings.description: No tracing (X-Ray/OpenTelemetry), no structured logging, no correlation IDs. Only print statements.
findings.gap: Cannot trace or correlate agent-initiated requests.
findings.recommendation: Implement OpenTelemetry instrumentation and structured JSON logging.

findings.title: No Alerting Configuration
findings.description: No CloudWatch alarms, no monitoring tools, no error rate or latency tracking.
findings.gap: Cannot detect degradation before agents experience cascading failures.
findings.recommendation: Deploy CloudWatch agent with error rate and latency alarms.

findings.title: No Infrastructure as Code
findings.description: No IaC. Manual deployment via git pull + apache restart. No Terraform, CloudFormation, or CDK.
findings.gap: No infrastructure governance. Manual, unaudited changes.
findings.recommendation: Implement Terraform/CloudFormation with PR review and drift detection.

findings.title: No CI/CD Pipeline
findings.description: No CI/CD pipeline. No GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or CodeBuild configuration.
findings.gap: Cannot detect API-breaking changes before production.
findings.recommendation: Implement CI/CD with automated tests and contract validation.

findings.title: No Rollback Capability
findings.description: No rollback beyond manual git operations. No blue/green, CodeDeploy, or canary deployments.
findings.gap: Cannot quickly recover from broken deployments.
findings.recommendation: Implement CodeDeploy with automatic rollback or container-based blue/green.

findings.title: No API Test Coverage
findings.description: README mentions stale unit tests. No test files in repository. Zero automated API test coverage.
findings.gap: Agent-facing API behavior changes cannot be caught by automated tests.
findings.recommendation: Implement comprehensive API test suite with pytest and DRF test client.

findings.title: No Encryption at Rest
findings.description: PostgreSQL on same EC2 with no encryption. No KMS, no encrypted EBS, no SSL for database connection.
findings.gap: User PII stored unencrypted at rest.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to RDS with KMS encryption. Enable EBS encryption.

evaluations.title: Asynchronous Operation Support
evaluations.reason: Extended question not triggered — no evidence of operations >30s or long-running workflows.

evaluations.title: Graceful Degradation Signaling
evaluations.reason: Extended question not triggered — no P0 priority specified and no evidence of critical path placement.

evaluations.title: Semantically Meaningful Field Names
evaluations.reason: Field names (id, subject, requester, priority, status, created) are human-readable and semantically meaningful. No legacy abbreviations.

evaluations.title: Business Outcome Metrics
evaluations.reason: No metrics or telemetry surface exists — informational signal, no finding emitted.

items.summary: Resolve all BLOCKERs and critical RISK-SAFETY findings. Focus on building a REST API, implementing machine identity, audit logging, and data safety controls.
Address remaining RISK-SAFETY and RISK-QUALITY findings. Build observability, CI/CD, and infrastructure governance.
Address informational findings and remaining quality gaps. Add event emission, rate limit documentation, and test coverage.

recommended_actions.action: Modernize runtime to supported Python/Django versions
recommended_actions.rationale: Python 2.7 and Django 1.4 are EOL. All remediation depends on a modern runtime that supports current libraries (DRF, OAuth2, etc.).

recommended_actions.action: Build REST API with Django REST Framework
recommended_actions.rationale: Without a programmatic API, no agent integration is possible. This unblocks all downstream remediation.

recommended_actions.action: Implement machine identity and audit logging
recommended_actions.rationale: Identity is the foundation for all authorization, audit, and suspension controls.
SQL injection, hardcoded credentials, and PII leakage are immediate security risks regardless of agent integration.
Data classification, residency documentation, and encryption protect user PII from agent-mediated exposure.
